tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch the customer's order by order id, or by their WhatsApp phone number (latest order). Returns a minimised view: first name, status, items, total, city, payment method, prepay link. Never returns the full address or full phone.

phone.description: Sender phone from runtime context, E.164.

tools.name: confirm_cod
tools.description: Record the customer's answer to the cash-on-delivery confirmation. confirmed=false cancels the order; include the reason in the customer's words.

tools.name: validate_national_address
tools.description: Format-check a Saudi National Address short code (4 Latin letters + 4 digits, e.g. RRRD2929). Normalises spaces, lower case and Arabic-Indic digits. Call before update_address.

tools.name: update_address
tools.description: Save a validated National Address short code (and optional delivery notes such as landmark or gate) on an unfulfilled order.

tools.name: get_tracking
tools.description: Get carrier tracking (SMSA, Aramex, SPL, J&T, Naqel) for an order: latest event, last 3 events, and whether a failed delivery needs attention.

tools.name: create_return
tools.description: Create a return for delivered items within the store's return window. The handler enforces the window and non-returnable categories (opened fragrance, opened personal care) and books a courier pickup.

tools.name: handoff_to_agent
tools.description: Hand the WhatsApp conversation to a human agent with a short summary. Returns support hours (and Ramadan hours) to tell the customer.
